name: Rug 200 × 300
notes: Generic example with typical sizes, not a specific product. Beige by default, as the user asked for a beige 200 × 300 cm rug. Besides any fabric, it takes the rug colorways (rug.*): two abstract watercolours that get busier towards the edges (rug.abstract-ivory-slate, ivory with taupe and slate clouds like the rug in the user's photo; rug.abstract-sand-rust, sand with rust and chocolate), a fine stripe (rug.stripe-ivory-charcoal, running lengthwise), a flecked berber (rug.berber-oatmeal) and plain wools: rug.light-blue, rug.chocolate, rug.mushroom, rug.sage, rug.terracotta and rug.slate-heather. Furniture can stand on it: it takes no part in collision checks.
